body.topic: de novo protein sequence design under stability constraints

qualification.spec: Fold the sequence at hash(colony, address, epoch) with ColabFold 1.5.5 against UniRef90 2026_01 and report its predicted melting point to one decimal. Correct within 0.5 C of the value the colony holds.
